requirements.title: Policy inspection is complete, deterministic and non-mutating

source.excerpt:
A pure resolver computes exact definitions, obligation membership, applicability
conditions, boundaries, references, conflicts and a deterministic definition
identity. It executes no project command or network call and grants no consent.

requirements.rationale: A proposed engineering definition cannot silently drop controls, alter old policy meanings or be mistaken for qualification or migration.

criteria.expected: Exact supported definitions account for every historical rule, retain mandatory controls and stable meanings, reject invalid definitions and preview the actual project difference without writes or command execution.

requirements.title: Explicit policy boundaries require current meaningful verification

source.excerpt:
Policy-2 replacement controls consume the ordinary current change review, not
project-level generic passing assertions.

requirements.rationale: Policy identity, capability applicability and current evidence cannot be silently downgraded or confused with selection, other stages or external-standard conformance.

criteria.expected: Schema-4 policy-2 evaluation preserves old selections, enforces capability/current source-stage control links, keeps known failures and external verdicts distinct, and does not qualify recovery without actual appropriate execution.

members.assertion: Complete historical accounting with unchanged retained definitions and exact external rules; distinct repeatable version identities.
members.discriminating_case: A missing historical rule, changed retained statement or preview that changes selected policy fails. Catalog 4 is now supported only through explicit schema-4 selection.

members.assertion: Unknown versions and IDs, missing replacements, duplicate definitions and orphan additions are rejected.
members.discriminating_case: Adding an unmapped or duplicate replacement must not resolve a smaller baseline.

members.assertion: Mandatory build/style/security/testing obligations remain and changed semantics change identity.
members.discriminating_case: Removing TEST-002 or keeping a digest after a changed normative statement fails.

members.assertion: Real CLI explains a replacement outside a repository, rejects unsupported requests and creates no files.
members.discriminating_case: An --apply flag or unknown rule cannot succeed; an empty directory remains empty.

members.assertion: Real initialized-project preview identifies legacy additions/removals and leaves contract/config/files unchanged.
members.discriminating_case: Any execution of the declared git config mutation, contract rewrite, or omitted baseline addition fails.

review.rationale: Reviewed all five assertions against this criterion: historical accounting and unchanged retained statements, invalid-definition failures, mandatory control retention/digest sensitivity, outside-project errors/nonmutation and real project diff/nonexecution. Complete input definitions and command dispatch are bound. Suite assurance, not named-case execution, conformance or approval; current execution remains required. Reviewed corrected historical-role wording and the direct human-output regression; historical presence is not automatic external-standard membership. Reviewed Policy2 changes: original assertions and legacy semantics retained; explicit catalog4 support does not activate policy during preview. Updated changed source/input bindings; schema and acceptance paths remain under tests. The superseded catalog4 rejection expectation is replaced by explicit schema/version tests.

members.assertion: Exact schema/policy selection, mandatory capabilities and report definition/stage are enforced by the real CLI.
members.discriminating_case: Schema3 with policy2, floating version, missing safeguards, wrong definition or missing report stage cannot qualify.

members.assertion: New control membership is enforced while historical standard findings retain separate verdicts.
members.discriminating_case: Historical rollback failure must not block Policy2 delivery; missing new recovery or affected flow must block its actual boundary.

members.assertion: Links require the exact definition, stage and an existing appropriate verification method.
members.discriminating_case: Wrong stage/digest, missing condition, missing binding or review-only recovery cannot satisfy the control.

members.assertion: Adding/changing control bindings changes the acceptance subject; absence retains legacy serialization/digests.
members.discriminating_case: A stage edit with unchanged digest or emitted policy_controls:null under legacy behavior fails.

members.assertion: Known blockers survive missing review; generic/project claims, stale fingerprints and false absence cannot pass.
members.discriminating_case: A present delivery capability or mismatched source cannot borrow a project-wide pass; error/failure/migration cannot be cleared.

members.assertion: A real recovery suite must run at its selected boundary with current control mapping; safe restore is not MinimumCD rollback.
members.discriminating_case: Evaluation-only, another stage, or deleted control links stay unverified even with green other checks.

review.rationale: Reviewed six all-required targets: explicit schema/version/capabilities; separate standard gates; current definitions and boundaries; digest compatibility; stale/generic/false-absence and preserved blockers; real recovery execution. Synthetic fixtures prove plumbing, not universal recovery adequacy. Suite assurance; known inputs are not a complete dependency graph. No consent or cross-stage qualification claim. Reviewed extraction of fixture setup into a helper after workspace-wide Clippy: all adversarial assertions and exercised outcomes remain unchanged. The three focused control tests and workspace Clippy passed after extraction.
